name: A Few Furs for Friz
summary: Cornelius asks you to carry lion hides to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port. The trade is arranged, and Friz is to receive the bundle.

sections.title: A Port Delivery
sections.body: At Powderfuse Port, Friz Frazzlespark is waiting for a bundle of lion hides. Cornelius has already arranged the trade. Deliver the hides to Friz and tell her they come from Cornelius.

faq.answer: The bundle of lion hides is for Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port.
Powderfuse Port is a goblin-run port to the northeast.

faq.q: What kind of hides are they?
